Research no payment / no prod-DB write; Sales no prod code; Marketing no GitHub write;

resurface a denied server. ⛔ FABLE-ONLY: REMOVING or NARROWING any entry here (= privilege widening)
requires a Fable-authored change with CEO-visible rationale. Additions (tightening) are allowed.
